scientific_scope: Observed-label catalog and descriptive null test only; no calibrated label probabilities, physical amplitude bound, primordial parity bound, matched-external-estimator claim, or formal preregistration claim.

primary_product.description: Science-facing catalog with equivariant hard labels and uncalibrated ranking scores. Raw-pass and reconstructed flip-pass score columns are absent by construction.

columns.name: class_eq
columns.description: Equivariant hard argmax observed label. Ties use deterministic first-maximum order CW, CCW, NOT_SPIRAL.

columns.name: score_cw_eq
columns.description: Finite uncalibrated equivariant CW softmax ranking score in [0,1]; not a calibrated probability.

columns.name: score_ccw_eq
columns.description: Finite uncalibrated equivariant CCW softmax ranking score in [0,1]; not a calibrated probability.

columns.name: score_ns_eq
columns.description: Finite uncalibrated equivariant non-spiral softmax ranking score in [0,1]; not a calibrated probability.

columns.name: score_eq_max
columns.description: Maximum equivariant ranking score; not a calibrated confidence or probability.

columns.name: primary_hc
columns.description: True for the declared primary sample: spiral hard label and max(CW,CCW) ranking score > 0.6.

columns.name: raw_flip_qc_unsafe
columns.description: True when a reconstructed flip-pass score from mismatched raw/equivariant pipeline passes exits [0,1] by more than 1e-3. The unsafe source scores are not included in this product.

semantic_validation_contract.scope: Full-catalog streamed validation over the exact Parquet bytes; uncalibrated score structure only.
semantic_validation_contract.object_id: non-null and unique over all rows
semantic_validation_contract.scores: all three uncalibrated softmax ranking scores and score_eq_max are finite and in [0,1]; the score triplet sums to 1 within absolute tolerance 2e-6; no calibration claim
semantic_validation_contract.score_eq_max: equals max(score_cw_eq, score_ccw_eq, score_ns_eq) within absolute tolerance 1e-12
semantic_validation_contract.class_eq: argmax of the score triplet with first-maximum tie order CW, CCW, NOT_SPIRAL
semantic_validation_contract.primary_hc: is_spiral and max(score_cw_eq, score_ccw_eq) > 0.6 with finite valid coordinates

quarantine_product.description: Machine-readable quarantine of every catalog-wide raw/flip reconstruction violator. These diagnostic scores are retained only for provenance and must not be used as calibrated probabilities or science weights.

recommended_filters.warning: The primary estimator consumes class_eq hard labels. Never use quarantine columns as probabilities, likelihood weights, or calibrated classifier outputs.
